note: *uma vítima de aclamação* was heard by the blind reader as a person harmed. Kept: *hóstia* is heard as the Host, and *sacrifício* belongs to *sacrifícium*. Both stay options.
*Sede o meu auxílio*, held against Latinist majors on both drafts asking *auxiliador* (D19, D24). One of the eight places where HANDOFF asks your ruling on *adjútor* more than any other word.
*Creio que verei*, held against Latinist majors on both drafts asking *Creio ver*, which is heard as "I think I see". The line is the antiphon of the Office of the Dead.

D36's headline verse: *Aguarda o Senhor … e espera pelo Senhor* keeps *exspectáre* and *sustinére* apart from *esperar em*; the difference rests on one preposition. *Espera pelo … espera pelo* is the option.
